mapper.select: SELECT id, issue_id, author_type, author_id, body, created_at FROM comment WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (id, issue_id, author_type, author_id, body, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{issueId}, #{authorType}, #{authorId}, #{body}, #{createdAt})
